deep_dnashape_verification.source_repo: https://github.com/JinsenLi/deepDNAshape (Li, Chiu & Rohs, Nat. Commun. 2024, doi:10.1038/s41467-024-45191-5)
deep_dnashape_verification.receptive_field_architecture_note: Deep DNAshape uses selfconv (Layer 0: 1-bp intra / 2-bp inter) + 7 message-passing GRU layers: Layer 1 = 3-bp intra / 4-bp inter; Layer 2 = exact 5-bp pentamer intra / 6-bp inter (DNAshapeR RF); Layer 4 (official default) = 9-bp intra (+/-4 bp) / 10-bp inter (union +/-5 bp across flanking steps).

channel_intersection.exact_7ch_intersection_fraction: 7/7 (100% of DNAshapeR RC-even channels present in Deep DNAshape)

alignment_meta.flank15_window: [F-5, F-4, F-3, F-2, F-1, N1..N8, F+1, F+2] (exact minimal union of 12-bp + DeepDNAshape_L4 N1..N4 RF)
